## RgbHelpers.from8Bit() method

Build a color from 8-bit channels, multiplying each by exactly [RGB_8BIT_SCALE](./contracts.rgb_8bit_scale.md) (so `255` becomes `65535` and `128` becomes `32896`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
from8Bit(r: number, g: number, b: number): Rgb;
```
